========================================
Initializer value carried by preproc arms
========================================

const bool useWorkaround =
#if QT_VERSION >= QT_VERSION_CHECK(6, 7, 0)
    false;
#else
    true;
#endif

int after = 1;

---

(translation_unit
  (declaration
    (type_qualifier)
    (primitive_type)
    (init_declarator
      (identifier)
      (preproc_if
        (binary_expression
          (identifier)
          (call_expression
            (identifier)
            (argument_list
              (number_literal)
              (number_literal)
              (number_literal))))
        (false)
        (preproc_else
          (true)))))
  (declaration
    (primitive_type)
    (init_declarator
      (identifier)
      (number_literal))))

========================================
ifdef variant with call expression values
========================================

static const Handler *handler =
#ifdef USE_FAST
    make_fast();
#else
    make_slow();
#endif

---

(translation_unit
  (declaration
    (storage_class_specifier)
    (type_qualifier)
    (type_identifier)
    (init_declarator
      (pointer_declarator
        (identifier))
      (preproc_ifdef
        (identifier)
        (call_expression
          (identifier)
          (argument_list))
        (preproc_else
          (call_expression
            (identifier)
            (argument_list)))))))

========================================
elif chain and mixed declarator list
========================================

int a = 1, b =
#if defined(X)
    2;
#elif defined(Y)
    3;
#else
    4;
#endif

---

(translation_unit
  (declaration
    (primitive_type)
    (init_declarator
      (identifier)
      (number_literal))
    (init_declarator
      (identifier)
      (preproc_if
        (preproc_defined
          (identifier))
        (number_literal)
        (preproc_elif
          (preproc_defined
            (identifier))
          (number_literal)
          (preproc_else
            (number_literal)))))))

========================================
Pointer declarator with preproc initializer
========================================

static const char *name =
#if VER > 2
    "new";
#else
    "old";
#endif

---

(translation_unit
  (declaration
    (storage_class_specifier)
    (type_qualifier)
    (primitive_type)
    (init_declarator
      (pointer_declarator
        (identifier))
      (preproc_if
        (binary_expression
          (identifier)
          (number_literal))
        (string_literal
          (string_content))
        (preproc_else
          (string_literal
            (string_content)))))))
